about_the_game:
Explore 51 retro levels of monsters, puzzles, treasures and secrets!

⚔️ 51 levels. Dozens of monsters. Underground puzzles. Dig, fight, solve – and survive.

Dragica’s Adventures is a massive retro platformer-RPG full of secrets, side quests, and clever puzzles.

In the upper world, fight ghosts, monsters, and evil plants. In the dark basements below, solve crate-pushing labyrinths, unlock hidden paths, and collect mysterious gear.

Use shovels to dig through graveyards, axes to chop forests, and pickaxes to smash through gold mines and pyramids.

Explore deserts, cities, forests, pyramids, islands and mountain caves – with shops, banks, teleporters, and magical upgrades spread across a huge pixel-art world.

ENG version 

Croatian version

🔹 Features:

  • 🎮 51 unique playable screens (levels/worlds)

  • ⚔️ Upper world = action & monsters; lower world = puzzle dungeons

  • 🧠 Puzzle mechanics (crates, balls, levers, secret triggers)

  • 🔧 Tools: shovel, axe, pickaxe – used for exploration & progress

  • 🧩 Secrets everywhere: buried paths, hidden items, unlockables

  • 🧭 Huge explorable world: old cities, pyramids, underwater islands

  • 🏦 Shops, bank, teleportation system, and equipment upgrades

  • 🎵 Retro-style visuals & soundtrack

  • 💻 Runs on Windows – no installation required (Java EXE)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 / 8 / 10 / 11
  • Processor: Dual-core 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (Intel HD Graphics or beter)
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Java 8 or higher required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.4 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or better
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Java 11 recommended for optimal performance
